title: Rotating Storefronts: Inside a Fake-Shop Network Gearing Up for Black Friday 2026
description: A large-scale fake-shop campaign is preparing for Black Friday 2026, using a Chinese SaaS store builder platform called oemcart. The operation runs thousands of domains, rotating them frequently to evade detection, and impersonates well-known retailers such as Aldi and Lidl. It targets shoppers primarily in Central and Eastern Europe, the UK, and the US. The campaign collects shopper contact details before payment and dynamically supplies payment endpoints at checkout to avoid detection. Infrastructure rotates among multiple cloud providers, and a parallel network impersonates premium fashion brands using WordPress/WooCommerce. Multiple evasion techniques are employed, including daily domain rotation, server-side payment delivery, and CDN usage.
